source_mode: Institutional Quantitative & Screener.in Empirical Research Framework
market_regime_note: In the NSE/BSE < ₹50 universe, 80%+ of stocks suffer from illiquidity, circular debt, or governance traps. To target a realistic 6-month rerating, the engine prioritizes 'Quality Value + Turnaround Momentum': high unpledged promoter skin-in-the-game, positive trailing earnings, low P/BV asset backing, manageable debt, and verifiable corporate catalysts (order book wins, debt resolution, or sector tailwinds).
screener_in_query: Current price < 50 AND Market Capitalization > 50 AND Return on equity > 10 AND Return on capital employed > 10 AND Debt to equity < 0.75 AND Promoter holding > 35 AND Pledged percentage < 10 AND Price to book value < 2.5 AND EPS > 0 AND Volume 1month average > 50000

rules.name: Promoter Skin-in-the-Game & Unpledged Holding
rules.ideal_threshold: Promoter Holding > 40% (or strong institutional/FII/DII backing) with Pledged Shares < 5%
rules.rationale: In Indian micro/penny caps, promoter conviction is the #1 safeguard against pump-and-dump operators. High promoter pledging risks forced lender liquidation during market dips.

rules.name: Trailing P/E vs Sector & Earnings Yield
rules.ideal_threshold: 0 < P/E < 22x (Positive EPS; discounted relative to Nifty Smallcap 250 median)
rules.rationale: Eliminates loss-making story stocks while avoiding value traps. A profitable company trading at 8x–18x P/E has room for multiple expansion over 6 months.

rules.name: Price-to-Book Value (Asset Backing)
rules.ideal_threshold: 0.3x <= P/BV <= 2.2x (Book Value per share provides downside floor)
rules.rationale: Penny stocks in infrastructure, banking, power, and manufacturing need tangible net worth (Book Value) backing so you aren't paying purely for speculative hope.

rules.name: Return on Equity (ROE) & Capital Efficiency
rules.ideal_threshold: ROE > 12% and Positive Net Profit Margin (> 5%)
rules.rationale: Confirms the business generates genuine economic returns on shareholder equity rather than surviving on equity dilution.

rules.name: Revenue & Quarterly Profit Growth Trajectory
rules.ideal_threshold: YoY Revenue Growth > 10% and YoY/QoQ Earnings Growth > 15%
rules.rationale: A 6-month target price requires near-term earnings momentum (upcoming 1–2 quarterly earnings releases) to trigger institutional and retail re-rating.

rules.name: Debt-to-Equity & Liquidity Safety
rules.ideal_threshold: Debt-to-Equity < 0.6x (for non-financials) & Positive Operating Cash Flow
rules.rationale: High interest burdens destroy sub-₹50 companies. Low leverage or active deleveraging turns operating cash flow directly into bottom-line EPS growth.

rules.name: 6-Month Relative Strength, RSI & Volume Accumulation
rules.ideal_threshold: Price > 50-DMA or 200-DMA support, RSI between 42–68 (not overbought), Avg Daily Volume > 1,00,000 shares
rules.rationale: Avoids 'falling knives' and illiquid upper/lower-circuit operator traps. Healthy delivery/trading volume ensures easy entry and exit.

red_flags_to_reject: Share Price >= ₹50.00 (Outside user's strict < ₹50 penny stock universe)
Average Daily Volume < 25,000 shares (Severe illiquidity / circuit-trap risk)
Deeply negative Book Value coupled with shrinking revenues (Insolvency / NCLT wipeout risk)
Auditor adverse opinions, SEBI show-cause notices, or >50% Promoter Pledge
RSI > 82 on low fundamental backing (Parabolic pump phase)
